content.text: This specification defines a comprehensive type system and formal semantics for safety-critical concurrent systems. The STRATUM framework provides:

items: **Formal Foundations (referenceMap("sec-XYQxS3DjhGgZ24R6PyyfR", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-8qxwzRxMeEWqbne8C5K8l", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-pYrht_aqaJ5gENPPS98r-", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-Jcn-W5ZXGpackkeeq-isa", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-CwnDzo78GYBw57r1EI_R5", "§{{sectionNumber}}"))**: Type system, abstract syntax, well-formedness, and seven guarantees (G1-G7)

**Operations & Profiles (referenceMap("sec-aBNKnM08R3W5pfjELaQas", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-FzfSSWJ73nYlWnpzz3-B7", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-xEbsOCjQmAy1Uj_H6qRLr", "§{{sectionNumber}}"))**: Query operations, domain profiles, and extension mechanisms
**Formal Theory (§10-27)**: Theorems, concurrency semantics, compositional properties, certification artifacts, and safety integration

**Implementation Support (referenceMap("sec-TmlplXlhpu2gAP4_iKrgd", "§{{sectionNumber}}"), referenceMap("sec-z3nlCPJ5B1h7TUhEf25LL", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-S3Z17-kDEc2A9A92Y0bqi", "§{{sectionNumber}}"))**: Reference implementation, proof templates, and language checklists

**Safety Standards (referenceMap("sec-z3nlCPJ5B1h7TUhEf25LL", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-S3Z17-kDEc2A9A92Y0bqi", "§{{sectionNumber}}"), referenceMap("sec-rRDDwm1LZy_CFk7nC2L0k", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-Nei3FTlw11oOPZVBq920l", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-x6eVbGvoVfS9GNeqNkLUG", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-dM0e66FHuNRBmoEaMjfxF", "§{{sectionNumber}}"))**: DO-178C/DO-330 compliance, ISO 26262 coverage, STPA/FMEA integration, and cross-standard traceability
**Type Soundness (Theorem 10.1)**: Well-typed programs cannot reach undefined states
**Progress (Theorem 10.2)**: Non-stuck evaluation for all well-formed definitions
**Preservation (Theorem 10.3)**: Type safety maintained across reduction steps
**GC Correctness (Theorem 17.1-17.3)**: Garbage collection preserves observable semantics

content.text:
STRATUM provides formal evidence for:
- Safety claim verification (ISO 26262 ASIL A-D)
- Functional safety compliance (IEC 61508 SIL 1-4)
- Assurance case support through mechanized proofs
- Tool qualification evidence for language implementations
